question: For this treatment use the supplied rule chemical mass = dosage × fluid volume. Dosage is 0.45 kg/m3 and volume is 280 m3. Find chemical mass.
answer:
To determine the chemical mass, we use the formula:

$$
\text{Chemical mass} = \text{Dosage} \times \text{Volume}
$$

Given:
- Dosage = $0.45 \, \text{kg/m}^3$
- Volume = $280 \, \text{m}^3$

### Step-by-Step Calculation:
$$
\text{Chemical mass} = 0.45 \, \text{kg/m}^3 \times 280 \, \text{m}^3
$$

$$
= 0.45 \times 280 \, \text{kg}
$$

$$
= 126 \, \text{kg}
$$

### Final Answer:
$$
\boxed{126}
$$
